hints.title: Independence of Cuts
hints.text: The area of each piece is height * width. Horizontal cuts and vertical cuts can be optimized independently.

hints.title: Find Maximum Consecutive Differences
hints.text: Sort horizontalCuts with boundaries 0 and h, and verticalCuts with boundaries 0 and w. Find max gap in each dimension.

hints.title: Product with Modulo
hints.text: Multiply max_h * max_w and return the result modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def maxArea(self, h: int, w: int, horizontalCuts: list[int], verticalCuts: list[int]) -> int:
        horizontalCuts.sort()
        verticalCuts.sort()
        h_cuts = [0] + horizontalCuts + [h]
        v_cuts = [0] + verticalCuts + [w]
        max_dh = max(h_cuts[i] - h_cuts[i - 1] for i in range(1, len(h_cuts)))
        max_dw = max(v_cuts[i] - v_cuts[i - 1] for i in range(1, len(v_cuts)))
        return (max_dh * max_dw) % (10**9 + 7)
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating every piece individually takes O(H * V) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Independence of dimensions allows finding max horizontal gap and max vertical gap separately.
